notes_for_editor: Very thin: one page line gives the only description (an alidade in a roofed pole shelter), with no date, builder or height. The Forest Lookouts page is titled 'Cougar Bluff' and its URL says the same, but its body heading reads 'COUGAR BLUFFS'; the record and TopoQuest use 'Cougar Bluffs'. TopoQuest's cliff is close to the record's coordinates (43.294564, -122.781442 against 43.294, -122.7808), so the lookout may stand on the cliff, but no source says so. Two web searches found no source linking a lookout or alidade to Cougar Bluff. The cached firelookout.org alphabetical list (firelookout.org/?p=1263) has no Cougar Bluff entry. Current condition unknown. The short story is deliberate.
